create_res_basic_stem: create a ResNet basic stem layer with Conv3d, BatchNorm3d, ReLU, and MaxPool3d for video feature extraction
create_acoustic_res_basic_stem: create an acoustic ResNet stem layer with parallel temporal and spatial Conv3d convolutions using ConvReduce3D
